QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_47

question.text: The CTR disclosure on 'Fund raising' confirms that an AIF may raise funds:

answer.text: Through public advertisements on broadcast media
Only by way of a private placement mechanism
By listing units on a recognized stock exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: The CTR row on Fund Raising states that an AIF can raise funds only by way of a private placement mechanism and requires the AIF to disclose whether funds were solicited or collected only by private placement. The Trap: Public advertisements, listing units on a stock exchange, and crowdfunding portals are not permitted channels under the private-placement rule. Note: Per workbook page 349.
